name: temporal-activity
notes: Faults sit between the activity and the plant. Run with: python3 evicon_review.py measure temporal (release 065: the driver starts a Temporal dev server on VM-D:7243 and the worker on VM-A: python3 conformance/reference/temporal_worker.py --temporal 192.168.107.153:7243 --plant-url http://192.168.107.150:28210 --task-queue <unique per run>; the fault proxy runs inside the probe on VM-C, port 28210 is inside the 28200-28215 range VM-A already reaches). late_factor 0.5 * 8 s = 4 s > start_to_close 2 s.
fault_model: network loss/delay, client abandon; owner up (no owner crash or reboot)
